body.statement: When \(n_B=n_S\), \(\Phi_{n_B,n_S}(R)\ge\Phi_{n_B}^{\mathrm{eq}}(R)\). The containment is strict: at \(n_B=n_S=16\) and \(R=4\), \(\Phi_{16,16}(4)=452>256=\Phi_{16}^{\mathrm{eq}}(4)\).
body.justification: A concrete strict delta distinguishes the catalog from a notational enlargement of the published equal-block family.
body.gap: The published equal-square calculation does not optimize over unequal block sizes even on a square population.
body.consumer: Researchers using the published \(k\)-block rule obtain a certified focal-size improvement without changing the randomization design.
